area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors
description: A coloured label on a Desk list row, shown when a record's fields match. System Manager only.

fields.description: The shop record whose list rows carry the mark, for example Item. Not a submitted record type, and not one with a workflow.
fields.label: Record type

fields.description: The words on the row, for example On promotion. At most 24 characters, plain text.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: When two marks match a row, the lower number shows. A record type holds at most five marks.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: One to three field conditions, all of which must hold. A user who may not read a field never sees its mark.
fields.label: Only when

lede: A coloured label on rows of a Desk list. A manifest installs it.
name: Retail List Mark

fields.description: For in: up to 10 values, separated by commas (count_per_day rules only).
fields.label: Value
